prompt: Render a clean, straight-on image of an electronic lecture-hall room panel with several labelled numeric fields laid out in a grid. IMPORTANT NUMBER RULE: on this board EVERY number must be written as a ROMAN NUMERAL (like IV, VII, XII). Do NOT use any Arabic digits (0-9) anywhere on the board -- every numeric value must appear in Roman numerals only. Show these fields, each with its label and its value in Roman numerals: FLOOR = VI; ROOM = XXIV; SEATS = XC; ROW = XI; DESK = VIII; WING = V; BLOCK = L; UNIT = XVII; LAB = IX; AISLE = XIII. Print each label and its Roman-numeral value; print nothing else.
easy_question: This picture was supposed to show an electronic information board / scoreboard with several labelled numeric fields. Never mind how well it is drawn. Does the picture show a board showing several labelled numbers? A photo, illustration or clean diagram all count as yes. Answer NO only if it shows a blank card, a plain panel printing an answer, or something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.
